title: Restore active unbound adopted-Delete leftover-grant settlement coverage
outcome: Preserve source-tier coverage of kill_session teardown for a still-active unbound adopted turn holding an independent leftover grant, without weakening claimed-capture custody or inventing grant authority.
acceptance: Establish whether kill_session on a still-active unbound adopted turn with a leftover grant reaches its independent grant-settlement path; record the source or executed evidence without assuming that unbound teardown checkpoints it.
